text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: F-Fuji! It's your birthday today, isn't<n>it?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
So um, tonight, if it's all right with you,<n>we were
thinking of having a—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Happy, happy birthdaaay! La la, dear<n>Fuuujiii! ♪

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: S-Spe, not yet! We're supposed tosing after we invite her to the partyand get the okay!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ahh! O-oh no, now I've done it!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Should I take that to mean...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what do we do, Suzuka? I<n>messed up the fresh
bob thing!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
C-calm down, Spe. And I think you<n>mean "flash
mob."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haha, thank you! You planned a<n>special surprise
just for me, didn't<n>you?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I should've seen it coming, but you<n>caught me
unawares. It seems I have<n>plenty of room to grow
yet.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now then, my dear ponies. Will you<n>gift me the rest
of your surprise?
